title: Haathi Mere Saathi
writer: Javed Akhtar, Inder Raj Anand, Sandow M.M.A. Chinnappa Devar
actors: Rajesh Khanna, Tanuja Samarth, David Abraham
plot: Raju becomes very attached to his four elephants after they save his life. His wife, however, fears for her child and tells him that he must choose between the animals and his family.
